notes: All pond-* backgrounds of one orientation share the identical composition (times of day are color grades of the same midday painting) and can be crossfaded pixel-for-pixel.
Koi face RIGHT (head at right edge); shadow baked offset down-right.

koi-*-segments: 4 cells of 256x128; cell i contains only the slice x=[i*64,i*64+64) at its ORIGINAL x position within the cell (rest transparent). Draw cell i at the same origin as the whole koi with a per-cell offset/rotation for bending; stacking all 4 unmodified reproduces the koi.
Dragonflies face UP (head at top). Leaves/pads rotate freely.
lily-bloom-strip: 6 frames of 192x192, bud -> full bloom, left to right.
Rings and caustics are near-white/cream with alpha; tint/opacity in code. caustics tiles seamlessly.
